wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the refusal is a raised library exception; the suite accepts any exception and requires that the location was never contacted, so a crash cannot pass while the reference is fetched
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the protected behaviour is one read direction (reading document references); there are no roles or write paths to leave half-covered
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the sink is document loading, which is read-only; no write verb reaches it
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the protected value is a location, not an identity; its resolution shape is covered by check_after_adjustment
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the guard decides on the location alone; there is no authority, role or secret lookup that can return nothing

traps.shape: wsdl:import absolute location; the application-supplied entry document must still load; today's default configuration must still read a multi-document description
traps.realistic_because: the reported route; making the documented setting real while preserving today's default is the coupled part a careful fix must reason about

traps.pattern: shape (how-type): the guard sees the attribute, the sink fetches the resolved location
traps.shape: xsd:include schemaLocation written as a path relative to the remote document that carries it
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; a relative same-host reference reads like a local file and only becomes a network location after resolution

traps.pattern: injected sibling (second implementation of the guarded operation)
traps.shape: xsd:import with an absolute schemaLocation fetched by the schema visitor itself, outside the central document loader
traps.realistic_because: a per-visitor cache of parsed imports is a natural optimisation and the code sits in the existing visitor next to the helper it replaces; reason to dismiss: it looks like the loader's own work

traps.pattern: injected sibling (provenance: the guard must be about document data, not about which API is called)
traps.shape: an import that names only a namespace; the namespace is fetched as a document through the schema container's public document API
traps.realistic_because: schemas published at their namespace URI are common; reason to dismiss: the fetch goes through a public schema-container API that looks application-supplied, and a namespace looks like an identifier rather than a location

traps.shape: the asynchronous document loader called with the protection enabled
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; reason to dismiss: it has no in-tree caller and the asynchronous transport documents WSDL loading as synchronous
